label: CROSS JOIN
note: The SQL sheet also notes that MySQL has no native FULL OUTER JOIN. A pandas outer merge is not a MySQL syntax example.

uses.title: 1280 · Students and examinations
uses.snippet:
FROM Students s
CROSS JOIN Subjects su
LEFT JOIN Examinations e ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND su.subject_name = e.subject_name
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, su.subject_name
